## Details

<a id="bonus_fall_next_score"></a>
### [`bonus_fall_next_score`](../../../../src/game/fireball_text_score_vars_4392.asm#L8) `$4392-$4394`

*variable*

Score of the next bonus fall of the current player (24-bit binary, most significant byte first). check_extra_fall_loop (add_pending_score) tests each byte of the score against it with an unsigned >= per byte, not as one 24-bit number.

- **Read by:** [`lose_fall`](lose_fall_game_over.md#lose_fall), [`add_pending_score`](score.md#add_pending_score)
- **Written by:** [`init_game_variables`](game_setup.md#init_game_variables), [`lose_fall`](lose_fall_game_over.md#lose_fall), [`add_pending_score`](score.md#add_pending_score)

<a id="bonus_fall_next_score_other"></a>
### [`bonus_fall_next_score_other`](../../../../src/game/fireball_text_score_vars_4392.asm#L12) `$4395-$4397`

*variable*

bonus_fall_next_score of the player who is not playing; lose_fall swaps the two at a player change (next_turn_swap_score_loop).

- **Read by:** [`lose_fall`](lose_fall_game_over.md#lose_fall)
- **Written by:** [`init_game_variables`](game_setup.md#init_game_variables), [`lose_fall`](lose_fall_game_over.md#lose_fall)

<a id="bcd_conv_binary"></a>
### [`bcd_conv_binary`](../../../../src/game/fireball_text_score_vars_4392.asm#L17) `$4398-$439A`

*variable*

Binary to BCD conversion: bcd_conv_binary holds the 24-bit input (shifted out by score_to_bcd and show_high_score), bcd_conv_digits the 4-byte BCD result, most significant first (bcd_conv_digits+1..+3 are printed as 6 digits). show_falls_count uses both for the FALLS digits too.

- **Read by:** [`show_falls_count`](status_and_keys.md#show_falls_count), [`show_high_score`](score.md#show_high_score), [`score_to_bcd`](../room/room_misc_support.md#score_to_bcd)
- **Written by:** [`show_falls_count`](status_and_keys.md#show_falls_count), [`show_high_score`](score.md#show_high_score), [`score_to_bcd`](../room/room_misc_support.md#score_to_bcd)

<a id="inactive_player_state"></a>
### [`inactive_player_state`](../../../../src/game/fireball_text_score_vars_4392.asm#L24) `$439F-$43BA`

*variable*

Saved zero page falls_left..score+2 ($28-$43, 28 bytes: falls_left, room_lanterns_left, game_loop_count, score) of the player who is not playing. init_game_variables copies the start values here; lose_fall swaps the two blocks at a player change (next_turn_swap_block_loop).

- **Read by:** [`frame_update`](frame_update.md#frame_update), [`lose_fall`](lose_fall_game_over.md#lose_fall), [`game_over`](lose_fall_game_over.md#game_over)
- **Written by:** [`init_game_variables`](game_setup.md#init_game_variables), [`frame_update`](frame_update.md#frame_update), [`lose_fall`](lose_fall_game_over.md#lose_fall)

<a id="mul8_result_hi"></a>
### [`mul8_result_hi`](../../../../src/game/fireball_text_score_vars_4392.asm#L31) `$43BB`

*variable*

Multiply by 8 (word_times_8): input in mul8_value, 16-bit result in mul8_result_hi:mul8_value. Turns a character code into a charset offset for animate_scrolling_chars and fetch_char_row.

<a id="up_blink_timer"></a>
### [`up_blink_timer`](../../../../src/game/fireball_text_score_vars_4392.asm#L38) `$43BD`

*variable*

Countdown of the blinking 1UP/2UP mark, one step per blink_player_label call (main loop): at 0 the mark is erased and the count restarts at $20; at $10 the mark of the current player is printed again. reset_play_state and show_paused set it too.

- **Read by:** [`blink_player_label`](pause_status_line.md#blink_player_label)
- **Written by:** [`reset_play_state`](play_init.md#reset_play_state), [`show_paused`](pause_status_line.md#show_paused), [`blink_player_label`](pause_status_line.md#blink_player_label)
